title: Creative Writing Iii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the language often used to describe effect and is not expected to be read literally."
Figurative language is the language often used to describe effect and is not expected to be read literally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of events arranged in a particular order."
Story is made up of events arranged in a particular order.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the tool and the medium through which literature expresses itself."
Language is the tool and the medium through which literature expresses itself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very exciting enterprise that requires deep and intellectually motivating skills."
The writing of poetry is a very exciting enterprise that requires deep and intellectually motivating skills.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a one semester course of two credit units."
ENG416 is a one semester course of two credit units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sequential arrangement of incidents in a piece of writing."
Plot is the sequential arrangement of incidents in a piece of writing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of "good English" because its writer uses simple, direct, smoothly flowing, and harmonious expressions."
Orwell says the above passage is an example of "good English" because its writer uses simple, direct, smoothly flowing, and harmonious expressions.
fib: ______ are the struggles between forces within the characters.
The internal conflicts are the struggles between forces within the characters.
______ means a picture (a mental picture of what we can see, feels, touch, smell, hear).
Image means a picture (a mental picture of what we can see, feels, touch, smell, hear).
______ is considered to be any writing, fiction, or non-fiction that goes outside the bounds of normal professional, journalistic, academic, and fictional forms of literature.
Creative writing is considered to be any writing, fiction, or non-fiction that goes outside the bounds of normal professional, journalistic, academic, and fictional forms of literature.
______ is the 'corner stone' of most research or writing.
Planning is the 'corner stone' of most research or writing.
______ is a skill that should look interesting to your readers.
Writing is a skill that should look interesting to your readers.
______ is the first principle and the soul of tragedy.
A plot according to Aristotle is the first principle and the soul of tragedy.
